verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents the general building blocks of a compliance program: unified controls mapped by auditors across its frameworks, framework-level control views, policy create, approve and publish workflows, built-in evidence requests, and scoping-to-final-report audits in one platform. However, SOC 2 itself appears only as a passing "SOC" mention in the helpbot docs. missing for 10: explicit SOC 2 framework page or docs, Type I vs Type II support, Trust Services Criteria control coverage, pre-built SOC 2 policy templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
